## Summary
- establish `dopemux rte` as the canonical operator entrypoint for Repo Truth Extractor
- align wrapper behavior, routing-policy inheritance, and validator policy expectations with the canonical v5 runtime path
- demote or hard-refuse divergent legacy entrypoints that are not exact-policy aliases

## Scope
- canonical operator entrypoint wiring
- wrapper and help-text alignment
- validator/default-policy alignment where required
- focused tests, proof, and implementation report

## Validation
- repo identity refreshed
- canonical command surface is explicit in code and docs
- divergent legacy surfaces are either redirected or exact aliases
- truth-run resume semantics and routing-policy inheritance remain test-backed

## Follow-up
Use a separate packet for broader UX or prompt canonicality cleanup if needed.
